modules.title: 旧地址怎样把访问者带到对应的新地址

items.title: 请求先到旧地址
items.text: 浏览器访问旧 URL 后，服务器或托管平台返回新的目标地址；浏览器再请求该地址，地址栏通常也会反映新的 URL。

items.title: 目标应有真实对应关系
items.text: 页面迁移、域名调整和登录后的返回都需要明确目标。目标内容相近时，用户不会失去原本想找的上下文。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: 重定向不等于单页应用中的内部路由，也不等于服务器重写。内部路由可在同一应用内更新界面；重写可能仍保留原地址。重定向的关键是访问者被明确带到另一个 URL。

lessonPractice.title: 旧地址 `/account` 要永久带到 `/settings/profile`，而且地址栏要显示新地址。怎样处理？

options.label: 配置到新地址的重定向，再访问旧地址检查最终 URL 和页面内容
options.feedback: 对。重定向会让浏览器继续访问新 URL，地址栏和内容都应反映新的目标。

options.label: 让旧地址直接返回个人资料页内容，但继续保留 `/account`
options.feedback: 这更接近服务器重写：内容可以变化，但地址栏没有被带到新的 URL。

options.label: 打开旧页面后用前端状态切换到个人资料区域，不改变地址
options.feedback: 页面内部切换不会把旧 URL 迁移到新 URL，也不能满足地址栏显示新地址的要求。

en.title: The old `/account` URL must permanently lead to `/settings/profile`, and the address bar must show the new URL. What should be done?

options.label: Configure a redirect to the new URL, then visit the old URL and check the final address and content
options.feedback: Correct. A redirect makes the browser continue to the new URL, so both the address bar and content should show the new target.

options.label: Return the profile page content at the old URL while keeping `/account` in the address bar
options.feedback: That is closer to a server rewrite: the content changes, but the browser is not taken to the new URL.

options.label: Open the old page and switch its internal state to the profile section without changing the URL
options.feedback: An in-page state change does not migrate the old URL or make the address bar show the new target.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请把旧地址 `/pricing-2025` 重定向到 `/pricing`，只处理这一组已确认对应的页面。改完后直接访问旧地址，确认地址栏到了新 URL、页面不是 404，且没有重定向循环。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Redirect the old `/pricing-2025` address to `/pricing`, handling only this confirmed matching pair. Then visit the old address directly and confirm the address bar reaches the new URL, the page is not a 404, and there is no redirect loop.

learning.assumes: You have followed an old link that automatically opened a new page or seen a 404 page.
learning.outcome: You can decide where an old URL should go and distinguish a real redirect from client-side routing or a rewrite.

modules.title: How an old address leads to a matching new address

items.title: The request reaches the old address first
items.text: After a browser visits an old URL, a server or hosting platform returns a new destination address; the browser requests it and the address bar usually reflects the new URL.

items.title: A destination should truly correspond
items.text: Page migrations, domain changes, and post-login return paths need a clear destination. When the content matches, people keep the context they came for.

modules.title: What it is not
modules.text: A redirect is not the same as internal routing in a single-page app or a server rewrite. Internal routing can update an interface in one app; a rewrite can retain the original address. A redirect explicitly takes a visitor to another URL.
